sources.title: README.md
sources.finding: Agentic software factory desktop app: parallel git worktrees, Cloudflare Quick Tunnels for remote and mobile steering, Whisper voice input, plan annotations, code review with verification gates, GitHub issue and jam.dev inbox; works with any CLI agent; installers for macOS, Windows, Linux; FSL-1.1-ALv2.

sources.title: LICENSE
sources.locator: Functional Source License 1.1, ALv2 Future License
sources.finding: FSL-1.1-ALv2, copyright Ivy Interactive: any purpose except Competing Use; each version converts to Apache-2.0 on the second anniversary.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/01_GettingStarted/01_Introduction.md
sources.finding: Local-first desktop app orchestrating Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini and OpenCode through plans and promptwares from idea to merged pull request; jobs dashboard with tokens and cost; verification gates; code never leaves the machine.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/01_GettingStarted/02_Installation.md
sources.finding: curl and PowerShell install scripts download the pkg, AppImage or Windows installer; run tendril; coding agent must be installed and authorised first.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/02_Concepts/01_Plans.md
sources.locator: Plan States; Creating a Plan; Plan Structure; Revisions
sources.finding: Plans are folders (plan.yaml, revisions, verification, artifacts, worktrees, costs.csv) moving through Draft, Blocked, Creating, Executing, Updating, Review, Failed, Completed, Skipped, Icebox; created from drafts, inbox files or recommendations.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/02_Concepts/02_Promptwares.md
sources.finding: Promptwares (CreatePlan, ExecutePlan, UpdatePlan, ExpandPlan, SplitPlan, CreatePr, CreateIssue) are folders with Program.md, Tools and Memory, run through the configured coding agent.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/02_Concepts/03_Lifecycle.md
sources.finding: Job status values, build/format/test verification with failure limits, configurable parallel job slots on worktrees, per-plan costs.csv aggregated by project, time and promptware.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/04_Apps/02_Review.md
sources.finding: Review app shows diff, verification output, plan text and Git tab; actions Approve (Make PR), Needs work (Revise), Decline (Discard), Manually resolve.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/04_Apps/04_Jobs.md
sources.finding: Jobs app shows status, type, tokens and live stdout/stderr; Stop, Rerun, Force Start (skips dependency checks), Debug, Delete.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/07_Integrations/01_Github.md
sources.locator: Importing Issues; Automatic PR Creation; PR Status Sync
sources.finding: Import GitHub issues as plans (up to 1000 per fetch), CreatePr pushes a branch and opens a PR via gh, PrStatusSyncService updates plan state when PRs merge or close.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/07_Integrations/02_JamDev.md
sources.finding: POST /api/inbox creates plans from jam.dev bug reports.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/03_Configuration/01_Setup.md
sources.locator: Settings app; config.yaml; Password on a server; Verifications
sources.finding: config.yaml with codingAgent, maxConcurrentJobs, projects, verifications, api.apiKey; BasicAuth env secrets for a server install; built-in verifications Build, Format, Test, Lint, Screenshots, CheckResult.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/06_CodingAgents/_Index.md
sources.finding: Coding agents run with per-agent profiles (model, effort) and injected environment variables such as Bedrock or custom base URLs.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/08_ModelProviders/_Index.md
sources.finding: Model providers are configured inside OpenCode and used by selecting OpenCode as the coding agent.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/09_Advanced/02_REST.md
sources.finding: REST API at the server URL (default https://localhost:5010); X-Api-Key header when api.apiKey is set, otherwise routes are open.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/09_Advanced/03_MCP.md
sources.finding: tendril mcp stdio server exposes plan tools (tendril_get_plan, list_plans, inbox, plan_set, add_repo) to agents; TENDRIL_MCP_TOKEN optional.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/05_ReleaseNotes/01_ReleaseNotes.md
sources.finding: Release notes: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel QR code on the dashboard, Share Mode tunnel beta, session password protection, beta-flag isolation.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril/TELEMETRY.md
sources.finding: Opt-out PostHog telemetry on by default, disabled with telemetry: false in settings; random anonymous GUID; aggregate non-identifying data only.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril/Commands/CliDispatcher.cs
sources.finding: CLI commands for plan create/get/set/list, dependsOn, worktrees, verification, job start/status/cancel, vault, config, doctor, mcp, promptware run and memory.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril/Services/Plans/DependencyChecker.cs
sources.finding: Plans can depend on other plans (PlanAddDependsOnCommand) and dependency checks gate job start unless forced.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Agents/Providers
sources.locator: Antigravity, Claude, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Ivy, OpenAiProxy, OpenCode
sources.finding: Agent provider implementations for eight providers, including a Claude invocation with --dangerously-skip-permissions or permission-mode and Gemini --yolo.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril/Services/Tunnel/CloudflaredService.cs
sources.finding: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel service and share tunnel for remote access.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril/Auth/TendrilAuthProvider.cs
sources.finding: Single shared password authentication with rate limiting; no per-user roles or SSO providers in the Auth folder.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril/Apps/Settings/NotificationsSetupView.cs
sources.finding: Settings offer a desktop notifications toggle.

sources.title: extensions/vscode/README.md
sources.finding: VS Code extension 0.1.0 with embedded dashboard, activity bar, server lifecycle, native diff editors for worktree changes and an IDE bridge; pricing Free.

sources.title: extensions/vscode/package.json
sources.finding: Extension package declares pricing Free and license FSL.

sources.title: Dockerfile
sources.finding: Dockerfile for running Tendril in a container (hosted server use).

sources.title: README
sources.finding: Ivy-Tendril-V2 states it is a work-in-progress upgrade that will be deleted when finished; not current product.

sources.title: src/Ivy.Tendril
sources.locator: bounded search at v1.2.4 of src/ and docs: saml, oidc, scim, rbac, roles, spend limit, max-budget, rollback, schedule, cron
sources.finding: Bounded search found no SSO or role model, no scheduler, no spend cap setting and no rollback feature; only a shared password and API key.
